name: Metro Interstate Traffic Volume
description: Hourly interstate traffic volume for westbound I-94 near Minneapolis-St. Paul, Minnesota, paired with local weather features and holiday occurrences from 2012 to 2018.
owner: Minnesota Department of Transportation (MnDOT) / John Hogue
attribution: Hogue, John. (2019). Metro Interstate Traffic Volume. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C56S30.

geographic_coverage.single_station_limitation: This dataset monitors a single permanent automated traffic recorder (ATR 301) on westbound I-94. It does not provide city-wide or segment-by-segment speed observations.

disclaimer: HISTORICAL DATA NOTICE: RoadCast is an educational historical analytics system. Historical traffic volume counts do not represent current road conditions or guaranteed travel times.
